out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: - OBSERVED: half-half was stored at room temperature without marking 4 hour end point.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS prompted CFM to mark the half-half with start and end points.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: — Observed the concentration of quaternary ammonia in the sanitizing basin of 3-compartment sink less than 150ppm.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. — CFM will need to manually adjust the concentration of quaternary ammonia to 200-400ppm.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: — Observed that the chemical dispenser for quaternary ammonia at 3-compartment sink is in need of service.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. — CFM has placed a work order.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: GARNISH.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. EHS PROMPTED THE FOOD EMPLOYEE TO DISCARD THE GARNISH. RITZ CARLTON LOBBY LOUNGE (Inspection Date: 09/26/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.corrective_action: EHS EDUCATED THE CFM. CFM MADE A CUT IN EACH OF THE REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGE.

violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: THE FAUCET AT 3-COMPARTMENT IS LEAKING.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. A WORK ORDER HAS BEEN PLACED.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OF 2-DOOR PREP COOLER WAS 54F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. TCS FOOD ITEMS WERE DISCARDED. ENGINEER REPAIRED THE UNIT IMMEDIATLY.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level AT EACH BASIN OF 3-COMPARTMENT SINK is not observed.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the ENTRANCE OF KITCHEN BEING USED TO DUMP ICE.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS PROMPTED THE CFM TO PROVIDE MORE TRAINING. RITZ CARLTON LOBBY LOUNGE (Inspection Date: 04/02/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: PICO DE GALLO (50F) WAS STORED IN 2-DOOR PREP COOLER (COLD) FOR 4 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEM.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: A CARTON BOX OF LUNCH BOX WAS STORED ON FLOOR IN DRY STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. CFM RELOCATED THE CARTON BOX.
